Job Title: Creative Graphic Designer
Company Name: MYC Media
Location: Mississauga, ON, CA
Date Posted: 2026-07-27
Job Type: full
Remote: yes
Salary: $55,000
Job URL: http://ca.indeed.com/job/creative-graphic-designer-1bb07b2e885846a7
Source: indeed
Job Description: **Creativity Comes First**

MYC Media is looking for a highly creative Graphic Designer who can develop original concepts, solve visual problems, and turn customer requirements into strong, professional designs.

Creativity, portfolio quality, and potential are more important to us than years of experience. Experienced designers and exceptional recent graduates are encouraged to apply.

**This role is not for everyone. If you are not highly creative, do not enjoy solving problems, or prefer simply following templates and instructions, this position is not the right fit for you.**

**About MYC Media**

MYC Media is a full\-service visual communications, design, manufacturing, production, and installation company. Our projects include branding, signage, vehicle wraps, small\- and large\-format printing, trade show displays, window and wall graphics, digital design, and environmental graphics.

Unlike many design companies, we manufacture, produce, and install much of what we design, allowing our designers to see their work progress from concept through manufacturing and production to final installation.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop original concepts for branding, print, signage, vehicle graphics, digital media, trade shows, and environmental graphics.
* Create customer presentations, mockups, and accurate production\-ready artwork.
* Follow brand standards while contributing strong creative ideas.
* Use AI for design, research, image generation, problem\-solving, automation, workflow, and time management, including writing and refining effective prompts.
* Review artwork for spelling, measurements, layout, materials, color, and production accuracy.
* Manage multiple projects and collaborate with design, manufacturing, production, and installation teams.

**Qualifications**

* Strong portfolio demonstrating creativity, original thinking, typography, layout, branding, and visual problem\-solving.
* Ability to develop original ideas rather than relying only on templates.
* Strong Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop skills, with working knowledge of Adobe InDesign.
* Strong understanding of composition, color, hierarchy, and visual communication.
* Ability to use AI, automation, and effective prompting to improve design quality and productivity.
* Ability to identify and correct weak or inaccurate AI\-generated results.
* Experience preparing print\-ready artwork.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, communication, and teamwork.

Professional experience is an asset but is not the main deciding factor. Recent graduates with an exceptional portfolio are encouraged to apply.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in branding, vehicle wraps, printing, signage, sign permit and technical drawings, wayfinding, trade show displays, digital or 3D design, and manufacturing or installation processes is an asset.

**Career Growth**

Strong performers may advance quickly to Senior Graphic Designer, Design Lead, or Design Manager.

**Benefits**

* Dental, disability, extended health, and life insurance
* Diverse, high\-profile projects
* Fast career growth opportunities
* Stable, full\-time employment with a growing Canadian company

**How to Apply**

Please submit:

* Your resume
* A link to your portfolio
* Your salary expectations
* A brief description of how you use AI, prompting, and automation in your design process and daily workflow

**Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.**

**Important:** Due to our IT security policies, we cannot access portfolios hosted on Wix. If your portfolio is hosted on Wix, please provide a Google Drive or WeTransfer link instead.

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a hands\-on creative design exercise.

Pay: $55,000\.00\-$85,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental care
* Disability insurance
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* Vision care

Application question(s):

* Please provide a portfolio link here
* Please confirm that you understand this is not a remote/hybrid position.
* Please provide your salary expectation
* A brief description of how you use AI, prompting, and automation in your design process and daily workflow
